what: Footer large wordmark: when the section’s top edge reaches screen center, the letter pieces rise one after another from 1.8 times the screen height below and settle in place (1s back.inOut, .05s between pieces). At the same moment the asterisk piece spins two turns (720°) over 3s after .2s, then shrinks to .6 times over 2s after a .5s delay and returns to full size over 1s (once).

options.from: Distance below before rising (multiple of screen height), default 1.8
options.shrink: Scale at which stars shrink, default .6
options.[data-fx-part=glyph]: Rising text piece (required) — a span becomes inline-block. SVG path and text also work
options.[data-fx-part=star]: Piece that spins after rising (only if present) — star, dot, logo symbol

note: In the original, each path of the svg wordmark rises. The pieces sit 1.8 screen heights below, so the consuming panel must hide overflow or the document grows (the part css puts overflow: hidden on the attached element)

from.where: index.html and all pages .fr-bigmark — footer wordmark letters rise and the asterisk spins
